family: Actual Boolean two-input outer gates with two disjoint two-bit children; fresh one-bit and two-bit shared-data selectors on two data bits
domain: All 16 outer tables and all 16^2 child pairs on each of three fixed physical product laws: uniform; (1/8,1/4,1/3,2/3); (1/3,2/3,1/8,1/4). All 16^2 branch pairs for one-bit selectors; fixed four-branch tuple (u,v,uv,u) for each of the same 256 pairs
symmetry: None; every constant and nonessential truth table retained
arithmetic: Fraction spectra from unnormalized centered-bit moments; identities of entropy as rational linear combinations of prime logarithms. Constants enclosed by rational series for exp, atan and log with explicit tails
purpose: Independent finite corroboration of analytic closure proof; not a universal finite-to-infinite certificate
